Ang tulo ka panguna nga kolor sa kahayag mao ang pula, berde, ug asul. Sayon nimo kini mahinumduman isip RGB!

Protein is made of tiny building blocks called amino acids, which your body links together like beads.

Why do ocean waves sometimes glow?

Bakit minsan kumikinang ang alon?

Ang ilang dinoflagellates tulad ng Noctiluca scintillans ay bioluminescent — kapag naaalog ang dagat sa gabi, pinaliliwanag nila ang alon ng magandang asul-berdeng kinang.

Ngano usahay mosiga ang balod?

Ang pipila ka dinoflagellates sama sa Noctiluca scintillans bioluminescent — kon maalog ang dagat sa gabii, pasigahon nila ang balod og nindot nga blue-green nga kahayag.

assignedReviews.reason: The card only names alpha, beta, and gamma radiation; it does not describe electromagnetic radiation as energy created by vibrations of charged particles or as transverse waves. Alpha and beta are not EMR, and no explanation of EMR properties is provided.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Meet the three main types of radiation: alpha, beta, and gamma — each one is unique!

copy.en: Meet the three main types of radiation: alpha, beta, and gamma — each one is unique!
copy.tl: Kilalanin ang tatlong pangunahing uri ng radyasyon: alpha, beta, at gamma — bawat isa ay kakaiba!
copy.bis: Kilala ang tulo ka nag-unang matang sa radyasyon: alpha, beta, ug gamma — lain-lain ang matag usa!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered two elements, radium and polonium, in 1898
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: discuss the significant contributions of early scientists in the development of the periodic table
assignedReviews.reason: The card states that the Curies discovered radium and polonium, which are elements that appear on the periodic table, but it does not discuss their contributions to the development of the periodic table itself. The competency focuses on early scientists' contributions to the table's development (e.g., Mendeleev), not on element discoveries.

copy.en:
What two elements did the Curies discover in 1898?

Marie and Pierre Curie discovered two elements, radium and polonium, in 1898, adding to our science knowledge!
copy.tl:
Anong dalawang elemento ang natuklasan nina Curie noong 1898?

Sina Marie at Pierre Curie ang nakatuklas ng dalawang elemento — ang radium at polonium — noong 1898, dagdag sa ating kaalaman!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang duha ka elemento nga nadiskobre nina Curie niadtong 1898?

Si Marie ug Pierre Curie ang nakadiskobre sa duha ka elemento — ang radium ug polonium — niadtong 1898, dugang sa atong kahibalo!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce

assignedReviews.card_evidence: take more than a year to develop before it finally blooms open
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the life cycles of mammals from birth to adulthood, birds from egg to a mature organism, and plants from seed to a young plant, and then to a mature plant
assignedReviews.reason: Months-to-bloom is one plant stage, not a comparison of mammal, bird, and plant life cycles.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A Rafflesia bud can take more than a year to develop before it finally blooms open
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Time-to-bloom is flowering timing, not pollination, seed production, or plant propagation as methods.

copy.en:
How long does a Rafflesia bud take to open?

A Rafflesia bud can take more than a year to develop before it finally blooms open.
copy.tl:
Gaano katagal bago mamukadkad ang usbong ng Rafflesia?

Ang usbong ng Rafflesia ay maaaring umabot ng mahigit isang taon bago ito tuluyang mamukadkad.
copy.bis:
Pila ka tuig molungtad ang usbong sa Rafflesia una mamuklad?

Ang usbong sa Rafflesia mahimong molungtad ug kapin sa usa ka tuig una kini mamuklad.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Rafflesia arnoldii flower can grow about one meter wide and weigh up to 10 kilograms
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a flower's size and weight, not about observing outer plant parts (leaves, roots, stems) or their role in water/nutrient uptake. It shares the plant domain but provides no instructional support for this competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The Rafflesia arnoldii flower can grow about one meter wide and weigh up to 10 kilograms
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe matter as anything that has mass and takes up space
assignedReviews.reason: The card gives an example of an object with mass and size, but it does not describe the concept of matter as anything that has mass and takes up space. It merely states measurements, so it does not directly teach the competency.

copy.en:
How big can a Rafflesia flower grow?

The Rafflesia arnoldii flower can grow about one meter wide and weigh up to 10 kilograms — one of the biggest flowers in the world!
copy.tl:
Gaano kalaki ang bulaklak ng Rafflesia?

Ang bulaklak ng Rafflesia arnoldii ay umaabot ng halos isang metro ang lapad at nakakatimbang ng hanggang 10 kilo!
copy.bis:
Unsa kadako ang bulak sa Rafflesia?

Ang bulak sa Rafflesia arnoldii makaabot ug halos usa ka metro ang gilapdon ug makatimbang ug hangtod 10 ka kilo!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not explaining how plants adapt to lack of rain or floods.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It's a parasite living inside a vine
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not living things interacting through competition or predation.

copy.en:
Why doesn't the Rafflesia have leaves?

It's a parasite living inside a vine, emerging only when it's ready to bloom.
copy.tl:
Bakit walang dahon ang Rafflesia?

Isa itong parasitiko na nabubuhay sa loob ng baging, lumalabas lang kapag mamumulaklak.
copy.bis:
Ngano walay dahon ang Rafflesia?

Usa kini ka parasito nga nagpuyo sa sulod sa liana, mogawas lang kung mamulak na.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Most plants are green because they make their own food from sunlight, but Rafflesia isn't
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: Naming food from sunlight is not describing the process of photosynthesis and respiration and their raw materials and products.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: it depends completely on the vine it lives inside for food

assignedReviews.reason: A parasitic plant depending on a host for food is not the roles of producers, consumers, scavengers, and decomposers in a food web.

copy.en:
Why isn't the Rafflesia flower green?

Most plants are green because they make their own food from sunlight, but Rafflesia isn't — it depends completely on the vine it lives inside for food.
copy.tl:
Bakit hindi berde ang bulaklak na Rafflesia?

Karaniwang berde ang halaman dahil gumagawa sila ng sariling pagkain mula sa araw, pero hindi berde ang Rafflesia — umaasa ito nang husto sa baging na tinitirhan nito.
copy.bis:
Nganong dili lunhaw ang bulak nga Rafflesia?

Kasagaran lunhaw ang tanom kay naghimo sila og kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa adlaw, apan dili lunhaw ang Rafflesia — nagsalig kini pag-ayo sa liana nga ginapuy-an niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: No — they're thick, firm, and rubbery, which helps this giant flower hold its huge shape!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a plant outer part (petal) but focuses on its structural role in holding the flower's shape, not on leaves, roots, or stems helping the plant get water and nutrients from the soil. It shares the broad topic of plant parts but does not directly support the competency.

copy.en:
Are Rafflesia petals soft like other flowers?

No — they're thick, firm, and rubbery, which helps this giant flower hold its huge shape!
copy.tl:
Malambot ba ang talulot ng Rafflesia gaya ng ibang bulaklak?

Hindi — makapal, matigas, at parang goma ito, kaya kaya nitong hawakan ang hugis ng napakalaking bulaklak!
copy.bis:
Humok ba ang petal sa Rafflesia sama sa ubang bulak?

Dili — baga, gahi, ug murag goma kini, mao nga kaya niini itago ang porma sa dako kaayo nga bulak!

What are the seven rainbow colors in order?

Remember ROYGBIV! The colors in order are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.
copy.tl:
Ano ang pitong kulay ng bahaghari, sunud-sunod?

Tandaan ang ROYGBIV! Sunud-sunod: pula, kahel, dilaw, berde, asul, indigo, at lila.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang pito ka kolor sa balangaw, sunud-sunod?

Hinumdomi ang ROYGBIV! Sunud-sunod: pula, kahel, dalag, berde, asul, indigo, ug lila.

assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions a rainbow, which is a light-related phenomenon, but it does not describe sources of light or their uses. It only states the colors, so it is not direct support.
